verification.scope: SE side cleaning window only (Mon+Thu 17:30-18:30, Apr 1-Dec 1). NW side remains not_established.
verification.method: Photo walk: two ground-truth photos matched against the joined set (see photo-walk-notes.md).
verification.se_photo: SE-side pole photographed 2026-11-16 16:26:21 (Nothing Phone (3a), no GPS EXIF): no-parking panel '17h30 - 18h30, LUN ET JEU, 1 AVRIL AU 1 DEC.' (plate code SB-JU; RPA table code SB-JU-A) paired with the 'P 2h 9h-18h LUN A VEN' panel (PV-PB). That cleaning+2h pairing exists in the data only on the four SE cleaning poles (163078 +94.0 m, 75043 +44.2 m, 234006 -42.8 m, 75038 -81.0 m). 'LUN ET JEU' is the abbreviation of 'LUNDI JEUDI' — same rule, not a mismatch. Exact pole unidentified (no GPS); immaterial since all four carry the identical window.
verification.sw_concern_resolved: The 7h-8h Mon/Thu pole at +174 m along-track (poteau 136123, panneau 1680691, SB-MU-A, '\P 7h-8h LUNDI JEUDI 1 AVRIL AU 1 DEC', 45.496284, -73.587781) is one of seven identical SB-MU-A poles running on a 231.1-degree line along Chemin de la Côte-des-Neiges (six sit 0.0-1.0 m from Côte-des-Neiges OSM ways, 136123 at 4.8 m; against the carriageway centrelines the row sits 5.6-9.9 m out), not on des Pins Ouest. The '+174 m along-track' and 'SE side' labels are projection artifacts of snapping a cross-street pole onto the des Pins centreline. The SW photo pole (PV-DB 15-min panel + '20 AOÛT AU 30 JUIN' PX-AX plate, no cleaning panel) is a different pole from 136123 (R-RA + SB-MU-A + AD-TT). No second cleaning window stands on the SE side of des Pins. No countdown suppression needed.
verification.sector_41: Photo-only finding: the SE pole also carries plates 'EXCEPTÉ VÉHICULES MUNIS D'UN PERMIS, SECTEUR 41' and 'EXCEPTÉ PÉRIODE INTERDITE' under the 2h panel. Interpretation: the sector-41 permit exempts the 2h limit only; 'EXCEPTÉ PÉRIODE INTERDITE' carves the prohibited period back out, so the 17:30-18:30 Mon/Thu cleaning ban binds everyone including permit holders. The dataset records neither plate. Phase 3 (Nov 17): the exception is structured data now (limits.SE.exception = 'SECTEUR 41') — a user who holds a sector 41 resident permit is exempt from the 2-hour limit only; the cleaning ban still binds everyone. The permit a user holds is per-user state, never in this file.
verification.still_owed: Full photo walk per BASELINE section 2.2 (every pole, both sides) is still owed — only 2 poles photographed. SW photo pole identity unmatched (PX-AX plate type absent from the entire 1,281-row dataset — pipeline gap). Exact SE pole among the four unidentified. FLECHE_PAN arrow ground verification still open. NW side remains not_established.

season_reading: Season dates are INCLUSIVE both ends: a window applies on Apr 1 and on Dec 1 themselves when that date falls on a cleaning weekday. The countdown and the .ics export use this same reading.

street.name: Avenue des Pins Ouest

segment_extent_along_track_m.sw_bound: Chemin de la Cote-des-Neiges, first carriageway (OSM)
segment_extent_along_track_m.anchor: 1624 address point sits ~+120 m, just inside the SW end; geobase line geometry unavailable (file downloads 403), so the extent is an estimate

street.centreline_note: Some ways carry placement=middle_of:1 — the mapped line may sit ~1 m off the true road centre. The 3-10 m band leaves margin for this; no calibration offset was applied (no ground truth yet).
street.ct_mapping_note: Centreline ordered NE->SW. Cross-track sign: + = SE side (1558 side), - = NW side.
street.verification_banner_html: Verified on my side. The window was checked against a photo of the physical sign on Nov 16, 2026, and the 7–8 AM sign at the far end of the block belongs to Chemin de la Côte-des-Neiges, not this street. The other side is still unverified, and the full block has not been walked yet. Always check the sign where you park.
street.segment_note: Joined to street segment ID_TRC 1260585 (Rue McGregor to Chemin de la Côte-des-Neiges) from signs 3–10 m off the road centreline; a window counts as established only when two or more poles carry the identical sign. Season Apr 1 – Dec 1 inclusive. Arrow codes on the signs (FLECHE_PAN) are not decoded in the open data, so no arrow is assumed to mean both directions. Centreline: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Times are America/Toronto.
street.permit_note_html: Resident permits: the photographed SE sign also carries “EXCEPTÉ VÉHICULES MUNIS D’UN PERMIS, SECTEUR 41” — that plate exempts the 2-hour limit only, not the cleaning ban; during the cleaning window permit holders must still move the car.

method.fleche_pan: UNKNOWN — no codebook found (web search, dataset resources, empirical pairing analysis: codes 2/3 co-occur on the same poles in a pattern consistent with opposite directions, but which is which is unproven). Recorded verbatim, never used to disambiguate, never assumed to mean both directions.
notes: A sign is attributed to des Pins Ouest only if: 3-10 m from the OSM centreline, nearest point inside segment ID_TRC 1260585 (McGregor to Cote-des-Neiges), and >=20 m along-track from either segment end. No nearest-sign fallback, ever.
A side's window is established only when >=2 poles carry the identical parsed window (same weekdays, hours, season) AND the CODE_RPA canonical text parses to that same window.
Parser is a whitelist grammar: \P prefix, one Hh/HhMM hour range, 1-7 full French weekday names, explicit D MONTH AU D MONTH season. Anything else is ambiguous.
EXCEPTE S3R is a flag (conservative default: restriction applies). Any other EXCEPTE/SAUF makes the sign ambiguous.
EN TOUT TEMPS is a permanent ban, never a window. \P = parking, \A = stopping.
Two different windows on one side = conflict: no countdown until resolved.

NW.permanent_ban_note: 5 no-parking-at-all-times panel(s) (\P EN TOUT TEMPS) stand on this side in the data — but each panel's reach is set by its arrow (FLECHE_PAN, undecodable), so the data cannot say whether they cover the whole side or only short stretches. 3 no-stopping panel(s) (\A EN TOUT TEMPS) also stand on this side.
